title: Certificates of Deposit: carrying out or replacing a maturity payout instruction
content:
## Scope

This rule states, for a Certificates of Deposit certificate whose grace outcome is still to come, when a payout instruction is carried out as written, when it is replaced, what replaces it, and which instructions are left untouched.

## Rule

1. **Only into an open account.** A payout instruction is carried out only into an account that is still open.
2. **Open account: carried out as written.** A payout instruction whose payout account is open is carried out as written: when the grace period ends, the whole balance is paid as a maturity payout to that account and the certificate closes. A mail-a-check instruction pays the whole balance by official check.
3. **Closed account: replaced.** When the maturity instruction is pay out to checking or pay out to savings and the payout account it names has been closed, the instruction cannot be carried out when the grace period ends. It is replaced by the automatic renewal instruction where the tier makes automatic renewal available, and by the mail-a-check instruction, under which the whole balance is paid by official check, where it does not.
4. **Only while still owed.** The replacement is made only while it is still owed for the certificate and can still be recorded before its grace outcome.
5. **Left as they are.** An automatic renewal instruction, a mail-a-check instruction, and a payout instruction whose payout account is not closed are left as they are, and nothing is written.

## Decision table

| Instruction on record | Payout account closed? | Replacement still owed for the certificate? | Tier makes automatic renewal available? | Instruction after this rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay out to checking or savings | Yes | Yes | Yes | Automatic renewal |
| Pay out to checking or savings | Yes | Yes | No | Mail a check; the whole balance is paid by official check |
| Pay out to checking or savings | No | Any | Any | Unchanged; paid out as written when grace ends |
| Mail a check | Not concerned | Any | Any | Unchanged; paid by official check when grace ends |
| Automatic renewal | Not concerned | Any | Any | Unchanged |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| A payout instruction to a closed account is always turned into an official check. | Where the tier makes automatic renewal available it is replaced by automatic renewal; only where the tier does not is it replaced by mail a check. |
| On a tier without automatic renewal, a closed-account payout instruction is simply left in place. | It cannot be carried out, so it is replaced by mail a check. |
| Every instruction is rewritten when grace ends. | Only a pay-out-to-checking or pay-out-to-savings instruction naming a closed account is replaced; the others are left as they are and nothing is written. |
